    Profile

    The Kijin Benimaru has arrived from another world. He commands the military division of the Jura Tempest Federation. As such, he is sometimes known as the Samurai General. He was taken in and granted a name by Rimuru, and pledged his undying loyalty in return. He can be a bit direct at times, but his sense of justice never wavers. A reliable friend, he is often seen as Rimuru's right-hand man.
